desc: [UPSTREAM + paired static decode] Track explicit T6040 ATC PHY + SN201202x HPM support. The paired kexts prove the 44-bank ATC map, direct eUSB2 host branch, target SPMI Gen3, and SN201202x HALType5/AppleTCControllerType10 selection. Type10 turnOnVbus reaches an exact nine-byte HPM address-0x14 RMW: byte1 OR 0x0d and byte7 OR 0x08. HALType5 proves USB config/status/data-control addresses 0x23/0x24/0x55. This is not yet an R3 live recipe: address 0x14 has no proved inverse, and cached command, interrupt, power/config, disconnect, and repeater coordination remain unresolved. The maintainer-approved docs/SPMI_SAFETY.md now permits only separately reviewed, exact right-HPM2 stages: 092 builds hardened artifacts; 093/094/095 are R0/R1/R2; 096 owns detach/rollback; 097 is the later R3 link. PMU/charger/NVRAM/firmware, unknown endpoints, other HPMs, and unreviewed PHY writes remain prohibited. Exact host-only proofs: done/2026-07-24-t6040-atcphy-kext-bank-map.md, done/2026-07-24-t6040-eusb2-init-sequence.md, done/2026-07-24-t6040-hpm-spmi-discovery-boundary.md, and done/2026-07-24-t6040-hpm-class10-host-transition.md.
